subject: FinOpt workshop: technical dry-run and stakeholder alignment
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nsharma@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@finopt.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: FinOpt workshop: tech dry-run & availability

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. To make the customer-facing workshop as productive as possible, we usually run a short technical dry-run with the customer's engineering leads + our CS engineer (Marissa) to validate API keys, service account access, and a short console walkthrough.

Proposed 90-minute slots (all PT):
- Tue Apr 27, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Apr 28, 08:30–10:00
- Thu Apr 29, 11:00–12:30

Prep items we need from your side:
- A sandbox API key or service account (read-only is fine)
- List of attendees and their roles (engineering, infra, procurement if someone needs to join)
- Any firewall/egress constraints for outbound connections to redwood.ai endpoints

I attached a lightweight prep checklist (console-prereqs.txt) and an early draft of the workshop deck. If none of these slots works, share two windows and we’ll accommodate.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning on the agenda.

— Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: console-prereqs.txt (text, 3KB); training-deck-v2.pdf (PDF, 2.1MB)

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@finopt.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nsharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lydia Chen <lydia@finopt.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinOpt workshop: tech dry-run & availability

Thanks Nikhil — appreciate the checklist. Quick notes:

- Engineering lead (Vikram) is in Bangalore and will need an evening PT slot to join synchronously.
- Procurement (Lydia) would like to be included on any session where we talk about retention/SLAs; she may not need the full technical run but would join the last 20–30 minutes.
- We can provide a sandbox key, but it will take our infra team 3–4 business days to open the required egress rule.

Best availability from our side (PT):
- Tue Apr 27 — only 16:00–17:30 PT (Vikram can catch last 30)
- Thu Apr 29 — 15:00–16:30 PT (this works best)

Can you accommodate Thu Apr 29 at 15:00 PT? If so, can you add a short agenda item to cover procurement questions at the end?

Thanks,
Sanjay
Sanjay Rao
VP Product, FinOpt

Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:47:00 -0700

Thanks — Thu Apr 29 15:00 PT (3:00 PM PT / 6:00 PM ET / 03:30 AM IST+1) should work for us. We’ll plan the session for 90 minutes and reserve the last 25 minutes for procurement/retention/SLAs.

Proposed agenda (90 mins):
1) 5m — introductions and goals
2) 20m — console walkthrough (Marissa)
3) 30m — API enablement + live keys (Nikhil + Dev)
4) 10m — latency/throughput expectations and routing options (Dev)
5) 25m — procurement + next steps (Lydia join-in)

Prep checklist reminder: if the sandbox key/egress isn’t ready we can run the console/architecture pieces and do the API live calls in a follow-up 30-minute session.

I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm attendees.

— Nikhil

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@finopt.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nsharma@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lydia Chen <lydia@finopt.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinOpt workshop: tech dry-run & availability

That looks good — confirmed for Thu Apr 29 at 15:00 PT.

Attendees from our side:
- Sanjay Rao (VP Product)
- Vikram Subramanian (Eng Lead) — joining from Bangalore (will be late evening IST)
- Lydia Chen (Procurement) — will join the last 30m
- Tanya Morales (SRE) — will help with egress changes

A couple of asks from procurement: can you include a short slide on data retention options and audit logs? Also, we prefer to get the workshop deck 24h ahead so procurement can review.

Thanks — see you then.

— Sanjay

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: FinOpt workshop: tech dry-run & availability

Thanks for confirming, Sanjay — adding the data retention + audit logs slide to the end of the deck and moving the procurement bullet to the 25-minute slot.

I’ve attached the updated deck (training-deck-v2.pdf) and a short console prerequisites file (console-prereqs.txt). Please review and let us know if procurement needs any additional wording for the SLA/retention slide.

On logistics: Nikhil — I’ll own the console demo; Dev can handle the API deep-dive. I’ll also run a 15-minute dry-run with Dev on Wed Apr 28 at 09:00 PT to make sure the notebook end-to-end demo executes within timing. Would you both be available for that quick run-through?

— Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
